product_one_liner.value: Auterion provides an open autonomy software platform, operating system, and fleet-management tools for drone and other autonomous-vehicle manufacturers, government users, and enterprise operators.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage describes an autonomy platform for autonomous systems and planning, executing, and monitoring operations.

pricing_page.notes: The site directs prospects to request pricing/contact sales rather than offering a public pricing page.

named_customers.notes: Auterion identifies these as part of its global customer base; these are presented as customers, not merely partners.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn company profile lists 201–500 employees (and 205 employees).

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Arlington, Virginia as headquarters; Auterion lists its US HQ address in Arlington.

founded_year.notes: Company profile lists 2017 as the founding year.

eng_blog.notes: The company has a blog/news area, but retrieved index results do not adequately establish whether there are at least two qualifying engineering-authored technical posts; cannot assert false.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product guides, development, integration and FAQ material.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A careers page/job board exists, but no available listing evidence established an AI/ML/data-science titled open role.

model_provider.notes: No public material found identifying a specific AI model or model provider used by Auterion products.

compliance_certs.notes: No security/trust/legal page establishing whether any of the specified certifications are claimed was located in the available research.

last_funding.notes: Company announcement dated September 23, 2025 states $130 million Series B. A purported later Series C result was found only in secondary listings with conflicting dates and no verified announcement, so not treated as established.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced September 23, 2025, within the 18-month window before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Auterion has a current careers page/job board, but no SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive title was identified.

launched_6mo.notes: Auterion announced a new AuterionOS/HYDRIS integration on October 19, 2026; it also announced the Shrike production initiative on July 13, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The company page gives a leadership roster, but no verified start dates for the current executives or relevant departure announcement were established.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Careers page and docs were available, but no cited job post, documentation or integrations page naming a CRM or sales/marketing system was found.
